summary: Backend-only iteration 6. Verified the /api/admin/users aggregation optimization (N+1 count_documents → single $group aggregation). Wrote 9 focused pytest cases at /app/backend/tests/test_admin_users_aggregation.py — ALL 9/9 PASSED against the public URL. Coverage: (1) Admin login admin@aleeclub.com / Admin@123 → 200, JWT decodes to role='admin', /auth/me confirms. (2) /api/admin/users returns a list where every user has integer application_count and paid_count fields, both >=0, with paid_count<=application_count. (3) Seeded 3 fresh TEST_agg_* users via /auth/register and applied to a real paid event (Miss & Mr Teen India 2026, fee=120000 paise): user A = 1 non-draft + 1 draft + payment /payments/verify(mock=true) → aggregation returned application_count=1, paid_count=1 (drafts correctly excluded, paid correctly counted). User B = 1 non-draft (unpaid) + 1 draft → 1/0. User C = 0 apps → 0/0 (edge case for the aggregation — the $lookup miss branch correctly defaults to 0/0 via counts_map.get()). (4) Regression on GET /api/admin/users/{uid} returned 200 with {user, applications, payments, certificates}, and the non-draft applications count in the detail response matched the aggregation's application_count. 404 for unknown uid. (5) Regression on GET /api/admin/analytics returned 200 with all expected keys (users, events, applications, by_status, revenue_paise) as integers. Note: the review request mentioned '/admin/stats' but the actual endpoint is '/admin/analytics' — tested the real one. (6) Non-admin (participant) hitting /api/admin/users → 403. (7) No MongoDB _id or password_hash leaked in /admin/users response. No 500s in backend logs; response shape is IDENTICAL to the pre-optimization contract.

minor.issue: Review request references '/admin/stats' but the actual endpoint in server.py is '/admin/analytics'. Not a bug — just documentation drift. Tested the real endpoint successfully.

action_items: None blocking. The aggregation optimization is correct and preserves the response shape.
critical_code_review_comments: server.py:934-965 — /admin/users aggregation is well-formed: $match {user_id: {$in: user_ids}} keeps it index-friendly, $group with $cond correctly maps 'is_draft != true' → application_count and 'payment_status == paid' → paid_count. The $ne against True (rather than $eq false) also treats missing is_draft as non-draft, which matches the previous count_documents filter {'is_draft': {'$ne': True}} semantics if that was used — worth confirming. In our tests both non-draft (is_draft=False) and draft (is_draft=True) documents were counted correctly.

server.py:961-964 — counts_map.get(it.get('id'), {}) with .get(..., 0) fallback correctly handles the zero-apps edge case (users with no matching group in the aggregation output), returning 0/0 as verified.

server.py:936-939 — projection correctly excludes _id, password_hash, and large media fields (portfolio_photos/videos, cover_photo) from the /admin/users list response — keeps payload small and secure.

Created 3 non-draft applications and 2 drafts against event 'Miss & Mr Teen India 2026'. Mock-verified 1 payment for user A. context_for_next_testing_agent: Public base URL: https://glamour-audition.preview.emergentagent.com. Run tests with EXPO_PUBLIC_BACKEND_URL exported (or EXPO_BACKEND_URL). The /admin/users endpoint now uses a single $group aggregation instead of per-user count_documents; response contract preserved (application_count + paid_count as integers per user). Actual admin-stats endpoint is /admin/analytics, not /admin/stats. Payment marking in tests uses POST /api/payments/verify with {application_id, mock: true} which sets payment_status='paid'. Duplicate non-draft applications per (user, event) are blocked by server, so tests use 1 non-draft + 1 draft per user against a single event — that's sufficient to validate the aggregation branches.
